name: Escape Circuit
description: Two players start with identical trays. Take turns sliding one block exactly one square into available space. Blocks cannot rotate, jump, or leave the tray. Get your orange core into the two marked squares at the bottom to escape. Both players get a slide in every round. If both escape in the same round, or neither escapes within 60 rounds, it is a draw.

cases.name: The first slide only changes its own tray
cases.description: Two players start with identical trays. Take turns sliding one block exactly one square into available space. Blocks cannot rotate, jump, or leave the tray. Get your orange core into the two marked squares at the bottom to escape. Both players get a slide in every round. If both escape in the same round, or neither escapes within 60 rounds, it is a draw.

cases.description: Two players start with identical trays. Take turns sliding one block exactly one square into available space. Blocks cannot rotate, jump, or leave the tray. If both escape in the same round, or neither escapes within 60 rounds, it is a draw.
